items: SMOKE CLOUD COLLECTION： We named our women's bodysuit “SMOKE CLOUD” because of the buttery soft C110TM fabric which can mould to your body and stretch to twice its size. When you touch it, it is just like a cloud of smoke.

items.label: Body-conscious Fit
items.value: This is a long sleeve bodysuit with double-layer fabric, a crew neckline and a thong-cut bottom. It's made with a soft, sleek, high-stretch fabric for its second-skin feel and smoothing effect.

items.label: Snap Closure Design
items.value: The Snap closure on the crotch makes it convenient for your lavatory visits and prevents positional changes.

items.label: Versatile Mix & Match
items.value: If there’s a singular wardrobe staple that does all the heavy lifting, it’s the bodysuit. You can easily pair it as a top with jeans, joggers, or skirts, or pair it as a base layer with jackets, coats and almost anything.

items.label: Wear for Any Occasion
items.value: This crew neck bodysuit for women is perfect for any occasion. Cocktail parties, clubs, dates, dance shows, beach, or just casual daily wear. When you want an all-in-one styling hero, nothing beats our Smoke Cloud bodysuits.
